common.scope: All17 literal /sites/ templates containing%s plus assembled group/location/photo routes and dynamic extension rules. Analysis-only normal-flow references are corroborated by original javap; no live legacy requests were made.

base_and_substitution.rule: y.e(path,value) returns null if aj.Q==null, even when path is absolute. Otherwise if path does not case-sensitively start with http, y.c(path,Q) joins slash boundaries; non-null value replaces FIRST occurrence of literal%s. Null value leaves%s unchanged. Empty value removes that occurrence. There is no generic printf or query encoder.

base_source.rule: aj.Q is server-supplied after login: field26.substring(0,field26.indexOf("/",7)+1). It is origin-like, not a hardcoded www host or a session-token query. The concatenator only recognizes http:// on base and prefixes http:// otherwise, so reproduce exact helper if compatibility is required.

escaping.rule: y.g replaces only ASCII U+0020 with%20; aj.a(url,body,...) applies it to non-P-prefixed URLs. Raw username/room/query substitutions do NOT escape &,=,+,#,%, non-ASCII or slashes. Page form builder concatenates fields directly then replaces spaces with%20; this is not standards-complete application/x-www-form-urlencoded encoding.

initial_page_method.rule: Built-in menu route calls pass null body, therefore logical GET (opcode922 field1 byte1, field2 URL, nofield3). Non-null body selects byte2 and field3, logical POST. This can be proxied via the binary connection; it does NOT imply the handset always performs direct HTTP to every page.

page_forms.rule: Remote<form> method defaults get and is lowercased. Literal get produces action+"?"+body (even if action already has a query); all other method values produce action with non-null body. Hidden/nonempty text/select/submit inputs and checkedcheckbox=on are serialized in page control order. Body encoding only replaces spaces%20. Redirect URLs remain server-driven.

direct_http.rule: u sees922 URLs starting https and uses direct helper. Also direct922 HTTP path when aj.b==1 and caller mode==2. In both, body!=null meansPOST application/x-www-form-urlencoded; otherwiseGET. The first helper declares Content-Length as String.length but writes getBytes(); other path declares byte length. Binary HTTP tunnel is separate: packet!=null→POST image/gif; poll null→GET.

static_fetches.rule: 1001(language list),1003(language resource),1005(username availability) are dispatched into direct HTTP GET helpers. Language list/resource URLs may be server-supplied and are resolved using y.d(gatewayBase,url). Packaged en-US/default_v2 do not require HTTP. MIDlet-Install-Notify is installer metadata, not an implemented client web request.

http://www.mig33.com/sites/index.php?c=r.expansion: Replace first %s directly with the Username field (var22). Uses y.b rather than y.e, so does not depend on aj.Q. Username editor normally lowercases input. No percent-encoding in substitution. bc.g queues1005 and u performs direct GET.

/sites/index.php?c=im&a=setup_im&im=%s&v.expansion: Replace %s with decimal selected external service ID h(ao).d, then y.e(result,null) resolves the base. Used for unconfigured service and Edit Login.

/sites/index.php?c=sms&a=home&v=midlet&f.expansion: Private chat: peer mobile s.c() when non-null, otherwise peer mig33 username s.f(). Roster SMS: selected contact mobile aq.d. Participant submenu action108: selected participant name var65. mig33:sms(argument): raw argument. Despite parameter name to_number, value can therefore be a username.

/sites/index.php?c=call&a=home&v=midlet&.expansion: Private chat: peer mobile s.c() when non-null, otherwise peer username s.f(). Roster Call: selected contact mobile. Participant submenu action106 also reads the CURRENT ROSTER selection mobile aq.d rather than var65; preserve that observed distinction. mig33:call(argument): raw argument.

/sites/index.php?c=profile&v=midlet&a=ho.expansion: Private User Profile: peer username s.f(); participant submenu102: selected participant name var65; roster View Profile/User Profiles/User Profile: current contact mig33 username t.e.

/sites/index.php?c=store&v=midlet&a=home.expansion: Give a Gift: private peer username s.f(), participant submenu100 selected name var65, or selected roster contact mig33 username aq.e.

/sites/index.php?c=lookout&a=home&v=midl.expansion: Whole suffix replacement, not scalar: &cid=<contactID>&pres=<presenceByte>. Roster branch uses aq.a and aq.j. Private conversation branch uses s.e() (peer contact ID) but still cached aq.j for presence; do not silently substitute a newly inferred peer presence.

/sites/index.php?c=account&v=midlet&a=tr.expansion: Private conversation uses peer username s.f(); participant submenu1000 uses selected name var65. Roster Transfer Credit uses aq.c (DISPLAY NAME) if non-null, not aq.e (mig33 username); this is actual code despite query parameter name. Credits menu and absent recipient use separate no-recipient route.

/sites/index.php?c=chatroom&v=midlet&a=s.expansion: Room Info in current conversation uses s.b room name. Rooms-list Room Info and Change Chat Room Themes branch use selected room-list item .c; the latter does not use a separate theme route.

/sites/index.php?c=group&v=midlet&a=add_.expansion: Replace first %s using y.b with current conversation s.b room name, then resolve resulting relative path with y.e(...,null).

/sites/index.php?c=report&a=report_abuse.expansion: Group-chat Report Abuse uses current conversation s.b (group chat identifier) for%s. Group%20Chat is already escaped in literal; no additional component encoding.
Chatroom Report Abuse uses current conversation s.b (room name) for%s.

/sites/index.php?c=profile&a=user_blog_p.expansion: My Blog substitutes current signed-in username from RMS profile field1 via y.b, then resolves base via y.e(...,null).

/sites/index.php?c=email&a=compose&v=mid.expansion: Send Email substitutes whole suffix &to=<selected contact mig33 username aq.e>. Compose Email substitutes EMPTY STRING, removing%s. Empty string is distinct from null (null would leave%s literal).

/sites/index.php?c=photo&v=midlet&userna.expansion: My Photos uses current username RMS1. View Photos uses selected contact aq.e when non-null, otherwise current username. IMPORTANT opcode504 fallback (normal bc1537) calls y.e(template,null): if Q exists it sends the URL with literal%s UNREPLACED. Record this as observed client behavior, not a missing inferred username.
/sites/index.php?c=photo&v=midlet&userna.null_substitution_case: Opcode504 response with no field1 URL and saved request field5==0; sends literal username=%s if Q non-null.

/sites/index.php?c=help&a=contact_us&v=m.expansion: Contact Us substitutes whole suffix &to=<current signed-in username RMS1>. It is NOT a recipient field supplied by user input.

/sites/index.php?c=buzz&a=home&v=midlet%.expansion: Buzz substitutes whole suffix &cid=<selected contact aq.a>&pres=<selected contact aq.j>. cid is contact ID; pres is presence byte.

/sites/index.php?c=group&v=midlet&a=list.expansion: Append &cid=<current conversation s.a>, the community/group ID. list_chatrooms and members append after y.e(...,null); view_forum and home concatenate before y.e. No query delimiter is synthesized beyond the explicit &cid=.

/sites/index.php?c=group&v=midlet&a=memb.expansion: Append &cid=<current conversation s.a>, the community/group ID. list_chatrooms and members append after y.e(...,null); view_forum and home concatenate before y.e. No query delimiter is synthesized beyond the explicit &cid=.

/sites/index.php?c=group&v=midlet&a=view.expansion: Append &cid=<current conversation s.a>, the community/group ID. list_chatrooms and members append after y.e(...,null); view_forum and home concatenate before y.e. No query delimiter is synthesized beyond the explicit &cid=.

/sites/index.php?c=group&v=midlet&a=home.expansion: Append &cid=<current conversation s.a>, the community/group ID. list_chatrooms and members append after y.e(...,null); view_forum and home concatenate before y.e. No query delimiter is synthesized beyond the explicit &cid=.

/sites/index.php?c=location&a=checkin&v=.expansion: Append raw l(String) argument after f=. Self-menu Check In passes literal HOME; mig33:checkIn(argument) passes its argument unchanged. Whole URL later has ASCII spaces replaced with%20.

/sites/index.php?c=photo&v=midlet&a=home.expansion: From My Photo when aO!=55 opens this page. Before navigation store current tab type in bl and recipient/chat key in bm (group tab4 uses s.b; others s.h()). Selected photo/link or mig33:sendScrapbookPhoto(argument) later sends message content type5 to saved conversation; this page request itself has no POST body.

/sites/index.php?c=photo&a=home&v=midlet.expansion: From My Photo when aO==55 (display picture context) opens this page; selecting returned picture sends display-picture update and restores Friends. No username query is appended in this branch.

http://www.mig33.com/sites/resources/lan.expansion: Change Language requests this absolute language-list URL via bc.b→1001. u.a(short,String,false) resolves against gateway base if needed, then direct GET, parsing response as a language-list packet1002.

http://www.mig33.com/sites/index.php?c=h.expansion: Passed to native browser/platformRequest by aj.k. Client does not implement the browser HTTP transaction; do not treat this as an embedded922 form or infer a POST body.
Passed to native browser/platformRequest by aj.k. Client does not implement the browser HTTP transaction; do not treat this as an embedded922 form or infer a POST body.

http://www.mig33.com/sites/c=migworld&v=.expansion: Synthetic/internal home-document cache key in bl.c(); lacks index.php? and is NOT a normal HTTP fetch in that method. It creates/caches a local s model and updates browser history. Distinguish from server-supplied actual home URL.
http://www.mig33.com/sites/c=migworld&v=.initial_request: no request at this call site

dynamic_routes.expansion: URL prefix + imType=<s.g()>&cid=<s.e()> forprivate; prefix+gcid=<s.b> forgroup; prefix+roomName=<s.b> forroom. No ? or & separator is inserted before first appended key; server prefix must supply it. Normal page opening handles spaces only.
Overlay1:prefix+cid=<selectedcontact.a>&pres=<selectedcontact.j>. Overlay2:prefix+gid=<selectedgroup.b>. Other custom menu URLs used unchanged. No separator inserted before cid/gid.

Notification roster row t.u is opened directly; Read Email uses server variable aj.P; Updates ClickLink uses ac.h() and bridge dispatcher, allowing mig33: commands. None is a fixed literal endpoint and no automatic recipient/presence suffix is added for these plain actions.

If not starting http: RMSfield9 image base + suppliedimagepath + ?w=<width>&h=<height>&a=1&c=1. Displayavatar helper uses G for both dimensions. Absolute http-prefixed values unchanged. No awareness of existing query delimiter.
